title: 第113章 昆仑为山门，重立道统
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

上万秦军锐士齐声怒吼，手中的长戈重重地敲击着盾牌，发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣。

那股由万千军魂汇聚而成的铁血煞气，在天空中凝聚成了一头狰狞的黑色巨龙，张牙舞爪，对着天庭的方向无声地咆哮。

这股气势，甚至让下方的李寒山等修士都看得热血沸腾，恨不得也跟着一起喊两嗓子。

这就是仙秦！

这就是始皇帝的军队！

敢于向天地挥戈，敢于向神明宣战的无上铁军！

然而，面对这股滔天的战意，顾长青的脸上，依旧是那副波澜不惊的表情。

他甚至还觉得有点吵。

他伸出手，轻轻地往下压了压。

那震天的喊杀声，瞬间戛然而止。

所有秦军将士，都立刻闭上了嘴，只是用一种无比狂热的眼神看着他，等待着他的命令。

顾长青看着嬴政，又看了一眼他身后那些杀气腾腾的士兵，叹了口气。

“说了，时机未到。”

他摇了摇头，语气中带着一丝无奈。

“嬴政，你这两千年，光顾着打仗，脑子都打傻了吗？”

“伐天，不是光靠喊口号就行的。”

他指了指天空，“天庭的背后是道祖，是天道。你想推翻它，就等于是在跟整个世界的规则作对。”

“光靠你这点兵马，就算再能打，冲进凌霄宝殿，又能如何？你能杀得了玉帝？还是能打得过那些圣人？”

“就算你侥幸成功了，你拿什么来维持三界的秩序？到时候天道崩坏，三界大乱，生灵涂炭，这……就是你想要的结果？”

顾长青一连串的反问，让嬴政脸上的狂热，渐渐冷却了下来。

他低着头，陷入了沉思。

他只想着打上天庭，推翻玉帝。

可推翻之后呢？

他要如何面对那些圣人？又要如何建立一个新的秩序？

这些问题，他以前不是没想过，但都被他用“船到桥头自然直”给搪塞过去了。

现在被国师当面点出来，他才发现，自己的计划，是何等的粗糙和天真。

“那……依国师之见，我等该当如何？”嬴政虚心地请教道。

他知道，论打仗，论治国，他或许不输于人。

但论到这种涉及天道和圣人层面的博弈，他跟国师比起来，就是个不折不扣的门外汉。

顾长青看着他这副样子，满意地点了点头。

孺子可教。

“很简单。”

顾长青伸出两根手指。

“第一，我们需要一个稳固的后方基地。”

“第二，我们需要一批真正属于我们自己的，能够与天庭正神相抗衡的中坚力量。”

他看了一眼下方，目光穿透了云层，仿佛落在了遥远的京城，落在了749局的指挥中心。

“而这两样东西，其实……都已经有了。”

说完，他转过身，对着空无一人的方向，淡淡地开口道：

“看了这么久的戏，也该出来聊聊了吧？”

“你们这些，负责人间的凡人。”

749局指挥中心。

当顾长青那平淡的声音通过扬声器传来的瞬间，所有人都感觉自己的心脏像是被一只无形的大手给攥住了。

他……在跟我们说话？

他知道我们在这里？

他知道我们一直在看着他？

一股寒意，从所有人的尾椎骨，直冲天灵盖。

在这种能够洞察天地，视万里如咫尺的大能面前，他们感觉自己就像是没穿衣服一样，所有的秘密，都暴露无遗。

“他……他让我们出去聊聊……”

楚嵩阳的声音都在发抖，他下意识地看了一眼窗外。

外面阳光明媚，可他却感觉比西伯利亚的寒冬还要冷。

“怎么办？周局？”王斌的脸色一片煞白，他看向了指挥中心里唯一还能保持镇定的人。

周玄策。

此刻的周玄策，脸色也同样凝重。

但他没有慌乱。

他知道，从这位顾前辈出现的那一刻起，他们这些凡人政府的命运，就已经和对方牢牢地捆绑在了一起。

是福是祸，都躲不过。

更何况，从目前的情况来看，对方似乎……并没有恶意。

甚至，还隐隐有将他们纳入羽翼之下的意思。

这是一个巨大的危机，但同样，也是一个前所未有的……机遇！

周玄策深吸一口气，眼神瞬间变得无比坚定。

“备机！”

他对着身边的通讯员，下达了简短而有力的命令。

“我们代表的是华夏，代表的是这个国家的十数亿人民！”

“我们不能退缩，更不能表现出丝毫的畏惧！”

“是！”

通讯员立刻应声，开始联系停机坪。

“老天师，”周玄策又转向一旁的老天师，用一种郑重的语气说道，“您是修行界的前辈，对这些事情比我们了解。这一次，恐怕要请您……与我同去了。”

老天师闻言，非但没有丝毫的害怕，反而眼中爆发出了一阵精光。

“求之不得！”

他抚着自己的长须，哈哈大笑道，“能有机会当面聆听此等大能的教诲，是我这辈子最大的荣幸！死而无憾！死而无憾啊！”

他现在对顾长青，已经不是简单的敬畏了，那是一种近乎于“朝圣”的心态。

很快，一架军用直升机从京郊的一个秘密基地起飞，载着周玄策和老天师两人，以最快的速度，向着淮南的方向飞去。

淮南上空。

嬴政有些不解地看着顾长青。

“国师，您找这些凡人做什么？”

在他的眼中，凡人，就是蝼蚁。

虽然他自己也曾经是凡人，但那已经是两千年前的事情了。

如今的他，早已是仙人之躯，寿元无尽。

在他看来，凡人这种生命，脆弱，短暂，愚昧，除了能提供一些信仰之力外，几乎没有任何价值。

更不用说，让他们参与到“伐天”这种级别的行动中来了。

那不是帮忙，那是添乱。

顾长青闻言，转过头，看了他一眼，淡淡地说道：“嬴政，你在天界待久了，是不是忘了，你这身帝王龙气的根基，在何处？”

嬴政一愣。

Page (1/3)

Tens of thousands of Qin soldiers roared in unison, and the Changge in their hands hit their shields hard, making a deafening roar.

The iron-blooded evil energy formed by the gathering of thousands of military souls condensed into a ferocious black dragon in the sky, baring its teeth and claws, roaring silently in the direction of the heaven.

This momentum even made Li Hanshan and other monks below see it with excitement, and they wished they could shout along with them.

This is Xian Qin!

This is the army of the First Emperor!

The supreme iron army who dares to wave to heaven and earth and declare war on the gods!

However, in the face of this overwhelming fighting spirit, Gu Changqing's face still had that calm expression.

He even found it a bit noisy.

He reached out his hand and pressed down gently.

The loud shouting of killing suddenly stopped in an instant.

All the soldiers of the Qin army immediately shut their mouths and just looked at him with extremely fanatical eyes, waiting for his orders.

Gu Changqing looked at Ying Zheng, then at the murderous soldiers behind him, and sighed.

"I told you, the time has not come yet."

He shook his head, with a hint of helplessness in his tone.

"Ying Zheng, have you lost your mind just because you have been focusing on fighting for the past two thousand years?"

"Fa Tian, you can't just shout slogans."

He pointed to the sky, "Behind the Heavenly Court is the Dao Ancestor, the Dao of Heaven. If you want to overthrow it, you are going against the rules of the entire world."

"With your few soldiers and horses, even if you can fight, what will happen if you storm into the Lingxiao Palace? Can you kill the Jade Emperor? Or can you defeat those saints?"

"Even if you are lucky enough to succeed, what will you do to maintain the order of the three realms? When the time comes, the law of heaven will collapse, the three realms will be in chaos, and all living beings will be devastated. Is this... the result you want?"

Gu Changqing's series of rhetorical questions gradually cooled down the enthusiasm on Ying Zheng's face.

He lowered his head, lost in thought.

He just wanted to fight in heaven and overthrow the Jade Emperor.

But what happens after it’s overthrown?

How would he face those saints?How to establish a new order?

It's not that he hadn't thought about these problems before, but he was able to explain them away by saying, "The boat will be straightened out when it reaches the bridge."

Now that he was pointed out to his face by the Imperial Master, he realized how crude and naive his plan was.

"Then... according to the Imperial Master, what should we do?" Ying Zheng asked humbly.

He knew that when it came to fighting wars and running the country, he might be as good as others.

But when it comes to this kind of game involving heaven and saints, he is an out-and-out layman compared to the national preceptor.

Gu Changqing looked at him like this and nodded with satisfaction.

Children can be taught.

"It's very simple."

Gu Changqing stretched out two fingers.

"First, we need a solid rear base."

"Second, we need a group of backbone forces that truly belong to us and can compete with the gods of heaven."

He glanced below, his eyes piercing through the clouds, as if he had landed in the distant capital, at the command center of Bureau 749.

"And these two things, actually... already exist."

After saying that, he turned around, faced the empty direction, and said calmly:

"After watching the show for so long, it's time to come out and have a chat, right?"

"You are the mortals responsible for the world."

749 Bureau command center.

The moment Gu Changqing's plain voice came through the speaker, everyone felt as if their hearts were being grasped by an invisible hand.

He's...talking to us?

Does he know we're here?

Does he know we've been watching him?

A chill shot from everyone's tailbones to the Tianling Cap.

In front of this powerful person who can see into the world and see thousands of miles away, they feel as if they are naked and all their secrets are exposed.

"He...he asked us to go out and talk..."

Chu Songyang's voice was trembling, and he glanced out the window subconsciously.

The sun was shining brightly outside, but he felt colder than the Siberian winter.

"What should we do? Director Zhou?" Wang Bin's face turned pale, and he looked at the only person in the command center who could still remain calm.

Zhou Xuance.

At this moment, Zhou Xuance's face was equally solemn.

But he didn't panic.

He knew that from the moment Senior Gu appeared, the fate of their mortal governments had been firmly tied to each other.

Whether it is a blessing or a curse, there is no way to avoid it.

What's more, judging from the current situation, the other party seems...not malicious.

There was even a vague intention of taking them under his wing.

This is a huge crisis, but it is also an unprecedented... opportunity!

Zhou Xuance took a deep breath, and his eyes instantly became extremely firm.

"Prepare the machine!"

He issued brief but powerful orders to the correspondent beside him.

"We represent China and the billions of people in this country!"

"We cannot retreat, let alone show the slightest fear!"

"Yes!"

The correspondent immediately responded and began to contact the tarmac.

"Old Celestial Master," Zhou Xuance turned to the old Celestial Master on the side and said in a solemn tone, "You are a senior in the world of cultivation and know these things better than we do. This time, I am afraid I have to ask you... to go with me."

When the old Heavenly Master heard this, not only did he not show any fear, but his eyes burst into light.

"What I wish for!"

He stroked his long beard and laughed loudly, "It is the greatest honor in my life to have the opportunity to listen to the teachings of such a powerful person in person! I will die without regrets! I will die without regrets!"

His respect for Gu Changqing was no longer simple, it was a state of mind that was close to a "pilgrimage".

Soon, a military helicopter took off from a secret base on the outskirts of Beijing, carrying Zhou Xuance and Lao Tianshi, flying towards Huainan at the fastest speed.

Over Huainan.

Ying Zheng looked at Gu Changqing with some confusion.

"National Master, what are you doing with these mortals?"

In his eyes, mortals are just ants.

Although he himself was once a mortal, that was already two thousand years ago.

Now, he has the body of an immortal and his longevity is endless.

In his view, mortal life is fragile, short-lived, and ignorant. It has almost no value except for providing some power of faith.

Not to mention, let them participate in an operation of the level of "Destroying the Sky".

That's not helping, that's causing trouble.

Hearing this, Gu Changqing turned his head, glanced at him, and said calmly: "Ying Zheng, you have been in heaven for a long time, have you forgotten where is the foundation of your imperial dragon energy?"

Ying Zheng was stunned.
